messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

set: ["call your doctor at once if you have these symptoms", "call your doctor at once if you have", "call your doctor at once if you have side effects", "call your doctor at once if you have chest pain", "call your doctor at once if you have tunnel vision", "call your doctor at once if you have blurred vision", "call your doctor at once if you have shortness of breath", "call your doctor at once if you have a serious side effect", "call your doctor at once if you have signs of liver problems", "call your doctor at once if you have watery or bloody diarrhea", "call your doctor at once if you have eye pain or swelling", "call your doctor at once if you have seeing halos around lights", "call your doctor at once if you have pain or burning when you urinate", "call your doctor at once if you have severe stomach pain or vomiting", "call your doctor at once if symptoms of stomach bleeding occur", "call doctor at once if you have signs of kidney problem"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:

  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
